lines.say: This time, the game dropped Milo and Jay outside a mansion. In masks. Next to a getaway van.
Milo. Why are we dressed like robbers?
Heist Crew. The only way out is to steal the golden idol.
I'm the hacker. I jam the cameras. You're the ghost. Silent, with a noisemaker.
And the vault only opens when two switches, in two different rooms, are held at the exact same time.
lines.cap: And the vault only opens when 2 switches, in 2 different rooms, are held at the exact same time.

lines.say: A guard turned the corner.
Jay tossed the noisemaker. The guard wandered off to check it.
Milo jammed the cameras. The lasers blinked out.
I'm on switch one. You get switch two.
lines.cap: I'm on switch 1. You get switch 2.

lines.say: Three.
Two.
One.
Now!
Click. The vault swung open. The golden idol was theirs.
Then the alarm went off.
Milo! They cuffed me!
The van was right there. Milo could have left. He ran back instead.
He freed Jay, grabbed the idol, and they dove into the van as the sirens hit the street.
The van floored it, straight off the edge of the screen, and back into Milo's bedroom.
Wait. Is that the golden idol?
Huh. I guess we kept it.
Heist Crew is real, and it's on Pulsebox. Four friends, five heists, one getaway van.
lines.cap: Heist Crew is real, and it's on PULSEBOX. 4 friends, 5 heists, 1 getaway van.

lines.say: Seventy-seven games. Which one should they fall into next? Tell them in the comments.
lines.cap: 77 games. Which one should they fall into next? Tell them in the comments.
